title: Gabor Frames of Totally Positive Functions
abstract: We formally verify in Lean 4 the following statement: if g : ℝ → ℝ is a continuous, integrable and totally positive function and if α, β > 0 satisfy αβ < 1, then the Gabor system {e^{2πiβnx} g(x − αm) : m, n ∈ ℤ} is a frame for L²(ℝ). This is the new implication in the solution of the frame set problem for totally positive functions, which is Theorem 1.1 of the paper "Gabor Frames of Totally Positive Functions: A Complete Characterization" by de Dios Pont, Gröchenig, Liehr, Shafkulovska and Taylor (arXiv:2608.04992).
